notes:
POC / Performance evaluation notes:
- Use case: online personalization + search re-ranking in fast path (must not add >200-300ms tail latency).
- Representative payloads: 128 token prompts for personalization ranking; 32 token prompts for click-predictions; embeddings for offline indexing.
- Acceptance criteria (customer): p95 <= 250ms for 128-token prompts at 800 concurrent sessions (sustained), p99 < 500ms, throughput >= 1,200 reqs/sec aggregated across 3 model endpoints. Cost target: <$0.008 / 1k tokens served (projected).
- POC setup: Dedicated cluster with initial commit 4 x NVIDIA A10G equivalent; autoscale policy to burst to 8 GPUs for 15-minute windows. Kernel/quantization: run quantized 16-bit / int8 variant from catalog (eval with Redwood SE).
- Load tests planned:
  * Day 1: stepped load to baseline (0 -> 400 -> 800 -> 1,200 concurrent) to validate routing and batching behavior. Capture latency histograms and per-token CPU/GPU utilization.
  * Day 2: stress runs with synthetic worst-case (long context, high sampling temperature) to exercise KV cache eviction and mem pressure.
  * Day 3: 72-hour soak at 800 concurrent to check steady-state throughput, memory leaks, and tail latency drift.
- Metrics to capture: p50/p90/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, queue depth, batch sizes distribution, kv-cache hit rate, error rates (429/500), cost per token metrics from Redwood Console.
- Representative prompts (short list):
  1) "Given user_history:[...], suggest 5 product variations tailored to segment B. Limit to 60 tokens."
  2) "Re-rank results: [itemA,itemB,itemC] by purchase_probability using context X."
  3) "Generate concise summary (<=50 tokens) of product review for UI microcard."
- Notes from call 2026-02-18: customer asked explicitly about SLA credits for misses on latency SLOs and ability to reserve GPUs for holiday peaks. Jordan: "We can do reserved commits + burst, but need procurement sign-off." Priya to provide realistic autoscale profiles and expected unit costs.
- Security: customer requires SSO + KMS integration and audit logs for all inference requests. Also wants optional data residency in AWS us-east-1. SEC ticket opened (SEC-2109) for proof artifacts (SOC2/ISO).
- Procurement: awaiting finance approval of 12-month reserved commitment. Customer prefers monthly invoicing but open to annual discount. Forecasted ARR if committed: ~$220k first year.
- Open negotiation items: exact SLA wording for latency SLO (p95 bounds vs. per-route SLOs), credits for repeated misses, DMZ/NAT IPs for Dedicated endpoints.
- Next tactical items (short):
  1) Redwood SE to provision 4x A10G test cluster by 2026-03-06 (Priya).
  2) PeakFlow infra to provide firewall allowlist + service account by 2026-03-07 (customer).
  3) Run 72h soak starting 2026-03-08, deliver POC report by 2026-03-12.
- Customer quotes: "We can't tolerate surprise tail latency during Black Friday style promos — need predictable p95 and an economic plan for burst."
